title: Reference Definition Changed Details
description: Recommended details shape for REFERENCE_DEFINITION_CHANGED errors, one error per drifted pin. error.field identifies the failing pin as a path into the proposal's commercial_terms, such as commercial_terms.definition_pins[2]. The details object carries the digest the definition resolves to now so the buyer can compare it with the pin it holds. Producer-authored values MUST remain buyer-safe and MUST NOT contain fetch targets, resolver errors, internal identifiers, or other producer-private detail.

current_content_digest.description: Lowercase-hex SHA-256 the pinned definition resolves to now, computed with the same projection as the pin. Omitted only when the entry was withdrawn from a successfully fetched, validated document.

pinned_content_digest.description: The content_digest carried by the failing pin.

reference.description: The closed reference identity of the failing pin, copied from the pin so a buyer can match by identity rather than by index.

pin_index.description: Zero-based position of the failing pin in the proposal's commercial_terms.definition_pins, matching the index in error.field.
